purpose: Detect complete valid ledger suffix deletion or rollback by comparing the local tail with an independently retained monotonic witness receipt.

trustLevels.note: Local HMAC/DPAPI authenticates content but ledger and anchor can still be rolled back together by a privileged actor.

recoveryStates.condition: Local sequence/hash equals the latest verified external receipt.
Local ledger is ahead of the latest verified receipt.
recoveryStates.recovery: Resume anchoring or quarantine unanchored records; never discard them automatically.

recoveryStates.condition: Verified receipt counter/sequence is ahead of the local ledger.
recoveryStates.recovery: Stop plugin, preserve evidence, restore only through an Owner-approved recovery event.

recoveryStates.condition: Sequence matches but tail hash, prefix hash, receipt chain, or anchor payload hash differs.
recoveryStates.recovery: Stop plugin and preserve both local and witness evidence.

recoveryStates.condition: The qualifying witness cannot be queried or signature verification cannot complete.
recoveryStates.recovery: Core Warroom continues; Research OS remains unavailable until verification succeeds.
Owner authorizes governance genesis and the first external receipt.

monotonicRules: witness_monotonic_counter strictly increases by one for each witness_id and ledger_id
witness_previous_receipt_hash equals the canonical hash of the prior verified receipt
anchor.previous_anchor_receipt_hash equals the prior verified receipt hash
